sources.use: Browser request-context headers and Sec-Fetch-User semantics; protected web-script headers are not authentication of arbitrary HTTP clients or a human operator.

sources.use: Covered components and insufficient coverage/replay boundaries; authority-bound stored outcomes do not bind unsigned UA, method or resource, or establish human-directed use.

Provider Verified classification includes identity and behavioral requirements; Direct/Intermediary is registry taxonomy. Local signature outcomes are not equivalent to a returned native provider verdict.
Google's published crawler/fetcher IP lists and forward-confirmed reverse DNS are documented identity methods. No DNS lookup or reader address transmission occurs here.

Google-Agent subset signing at agent.bot.goog is experimental; not every participating request is signed. This does not establish a Googlebot signing promise or expand our per-client mapping. Key cache lifetime and signature expiry are separate.

no-cache requires validation before reuse and differs from no-store/private storage restrictions. The six-condition contrast measures our current retained projection, not universal HTTP cache conformance or historical publisher headers.
